father_dinner_greeting_1.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Ah, there you are! Come on, sit down. Your Other Mother has made an absolutely marvelous dinner for us.

father_dinner_greeting_2.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Oh, wonderful! The whole family's here. I was beginning to think I'd have to eat your portion myself. Ha! Only joking, of course.

father_pass_bread.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Ah, would you mind passing the bread, kiddo? It's rather a long reach from here.

father_pass_potatoes.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Those potatoes look awfully good. Could you pass them over here for me?

father_dinner_comment_1.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Mmm! Your Other Mother really has outdone herself this time. I don't think I've ever had anything quite so delicious.

father_dinner_comment_2.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: You know, there's something rather wonderful about everyone sitting down together. Makes the whole house feel a little warmer, doesn't it?

father_dinner_question.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: So, what have you been getting up to today? Anything particularly exciting?

father_dinner_finish.direction: Warm, cheerful, slightly awkward and playful.
lines: Ahh, that was splendid! I don't think I could manage another bite. Well, perhaps just one more little piece of pie.
